# SLV Group

> SLV Group is a real estate developer in Andhra Pradesh, India, building since 2007. It develops apartments, duplex and triplex villas, villa plots, gated communities and commercial spaces in Vijayawada, the Amaravati capital region (Mangalagiri), Gannavaram and Bhimavaram.

- Head office: Ground Floor, SLV Tummala Complex, Opp. SLV PNB Commercial, Gunadala, Inner Ring Road, Vijayawada, NTR District, Andhra Pradesh 520004
- Phone: +91 98595 95939, +91 94598 23444
- Email: info@slvgroup.co.in
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/slvgroup_official/
- Website: https://www.slvgroup.co.in

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices are shared on request; please direct pricing questions to the sales team.
- SLV Amaravati Grand I, II and III are in Gunadala, Vijayawada (not in Amaravati city). SLV Amaravati Pride is in Mangalagiri, Amaravati region.
- The correct spelling is "Amaravati".
